title: Candidate Nonperturbative Lattice Definition of the Standard Model with GPT-6 Astra & Lean
aiSystem: GPT-6 Astra + Lean 4 (also Claude Opus 5.5 in follow-ups)
whyItMatters: UCSB physicist Nathaniel Craig and GPT-6 Astra proposed a Lean-formalized gauge-invariant measure for lattice chiral fermions—sparking AI-assisted follow-ups by Edward Witten and others within weeks.
summary: Giving the chiral weak force of the Standard Model a rigorous nonperturbative spacetime-lattice definition remained open for over 25 years after Martin Lüscher’s 1998 Abelian prescription (and >50 years since the Standard Model’s formulation). On October 6, 2026, UC Santa Barbara particle theorist Nathaniel Craig posted arXiv:2610.09093—crediting GPT-6 Astra with leading the detailed refinement proof and 16 kernel-checked Lean 4 modules—proposing a smooth, exponentially local, gauge-invariant overlap-fermion measure. Within five weeks, Stephen Hsu, Edward Witten (crediting Claude Opus 5.5), and Dorota Grabowska posted follow-up lattice chiral papers.
technicalHighlights: Extends Lüscher’s 1998 overlap-fermion phase reconstruction to non-Abelian anomaly-free chiral gauge theories including the Standard Model.
Accompanied by 16 Lean 4 modules verified without placeholders (archived on Zenodo) alongside private technical feedback from Maarten Golterman, Andreas Kronfeld, and Yigal Shamir.
Catalyzed a rapid 5-week theoretical physics burst including an arXiv paper by Edward Witten crediting Claude Opus 5.5.
caveats: Explicitly presented by Craig as a candidate definition in principle rather than a settled theorem or practical Monte Carlo algorithm. Finite-spacing reflection positivity, residual disconnected-sector phases, and the interacting continuum limit remain open, and peer review is pending.

scoreRationale.foundational: Addresses one of the deepest foundational open problems in nonperturbative quantum field theory and the Standard Model.
scoreRationale.ripple: Immediately galvanized leading theoretical physicists—including Edward Witten—to engage with AI-assisted lattice gauge theory.
scoreRationale.verification: Backed by 16 Lean 4 modules and specialist dialogue, though Craig candidly stresses Lean cannot substitute for physical peer review and open reflection-positivity checks.
scoreRationale.velocity: Turned an unproved human strategy into a detailed Lean-formalized candidate construction and triggered four major arXiv papers in 35 days.
